| description = <b>Note:</b> The standard respawn rate for Firbrand the Black does not use the 6:40 minute spawn like the others in Eastern Wastes. He spawns every 20:00 minutes and has a 50% chance pop (Possibly different on green. Camped this for 10 hours and only PHs spawned) as its' placeholder is the blacksmith Ry'Gorr. More importantly, his item Dark Ember is not a common drop. From estimated camping of 10 Firbrand's he never dropped it. Which implies that the only time he will drop Dark Ember would be 100% chance during the 8th roll ring spawn after the orders are turned in. Good luck! (editors note: I did receive a dark ember outside of the event, so it may just be rare)

4/17/2023 - Killed today (blue) and it had two pairs of Gauntlets, so Dark Ember is not 100% drop rate from Ring 8 spawn.

10/17/2023 - Two gauntlets on blue as part of ring 8

10/08/2024 - Two Dark Embers on blue as part of ring 8
